g.title: G
g.text: A2 | Purchase, approval and payment flow

g.title: intent
g.text: 1. Buyer supplies outcome, budget and deadline

g.title: facts
g.text: 2. AI proposes requirements and product facts

g.title: revise
g.text: user or trusted evidence resolves it

g.title: offer
g.text: 4. Freeze merchant offer and material manifest
merchant / variant / quantity / total / currency / expiry

g.title: create
g.text: 6. Persist order-create intent, then call PayPal
stable create key; store provider order ID

g.title: buyerpp
g.text: 7. Buyer approves the order at PayPal
browser callback is a signal, not payment evidence

g.title: commit
g.text: atomic budget / inventory reservation + capture intent

g.title: send
g.text: 9. Worker dispatches capture outside DB transaction
original order / body hash / stable capture key

g.title: unknown
g.text: read back / exact retry under provider contract
never mint replacement authority on timeout

g.title: declined
g.text: record refusal; release only justified reservations
